standard-dialogue-before-or-during-ghost.text: If the player wears either a ghostspeak amulet or the Morytania legs 2 or above:

steps.npc: All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens.

options.text: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.

steps.player: I would like to enter Port Phasmatys - here's 2 Ectotokens.

options.text: I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.

steps.player: I'm not paying you Ectotokens just to go through a gate.

steps.npc: You need to go to the Temple and earn some. Talk to the disciples - they will tell you how.

standard-dialogue-before-or-during-ghost.text: If the player does not wear either a ghostspeak amulet or the Morytania legs 2 or above:

steps.text: The ghostly guards wail at you incomprehensibly, and though you cannot understand their exact words you understand their meaning - you may not pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys.

standard-dialogue-after-ghosts-ahoy.text: If the player wears either a ghostspeak amulet or the Morytania legs 2 or above:

steps.npc: All visitors to Port Phasmatys must pay a toll charge of 2 Ectotokens. However, you have done the ghosts of our town a service that surpasses all value, so you may pass without charge.

standard-dialogue-after-ghosts-ahoy.text: If the player does not wear either a ghostspeak amulet or the Morytania legs 2 or above:
